messages.content: What's the weather like in Boston?

function.name: uber_eat_order
function.description: Place an order for food delivery on Uber Eats by specifying the restaurant and the items with their respective quantities. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

restaurant.description: The name of the restaurant from which to order food.

items.description: A list of food item names selected for the order.

quantities.description: A list of quantities for each food item, corresponding by index to the items array.

message.content:
I’m not connected to live weather feeds, so I can’t give you the exact temperature or forecast right now. However, here’s a quick snapshot of what you can generally expect in Boston:

| Season | Typical High | Typical Low | What to Expect |
|--------|--------------|-------------|----------------|
| Winter (Dec–Feb) | 30–35 °F (−1 to 2 °C) | 20–25 °F (−7 to –4 °C) | Snow, wind chill, occasional ice storms. |
| Spring (Mar–May) | 45–55 °F (7–13 °C) | 30–40 °F (−1 to 4 °C) | Variable; rain showers, mild days, occasional late‑season snow. |
| Summer (Jun–Aug) | 75–85 °F (24–29 °C) | 60–70 °F (15–21 °C) | Warm, humid, occasional heat waves; thunderstorms in July/August. |
| Fall (Sep–Nov) | 55–65 °F (13–18 °C) | 40–50 °F (4–10 °C) | Crisp, colorful foliage, cooler nights, early frost in late November. |

If you need a real‑time forecast, you could check a reliable weather site (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather, or the National Weather Service) or use a voice assistant like Siri, Google Assistant, or Alexa. Let me know if you’d like a quick summary of the current conditions based on the latest public data!
message.reasoning: User asks about weather. We can provide general info or ask for location. We can give current weather if we had data. But we don't have real-time data. We can respond with typical weather patterns or ask for date/time. Probably answer with typical climate.
